name: aidlc-tracker-jira
description: The Atlassian MCP server for AIDLC's Jira work-item adapter. REQUIRED when .claude/aidlc.config.json sets workItems.source: "jira" — the adapter has no CLI fallback, unlike Azure DevOps. Ships nothing but the server: the wi-jira adapter itself lives in core, so the pipeline's tracker contract stays in one place. Authenticate via OAuth on first use.
